# S & P Precision Parts

> S & P Precision Parts Sdn Bhd (Skudai, Johor) is an authorised distributor of Monaer brake parts: nano ceramic brake pads, coated high-carbon brake discs, DOT 4 and DOT 5.1 brake fluid and brake care items. Drivers can check fitment on WhatsApp; workshops can apply to become authorised Monaer workshops.

Site: https://spprecisionparts.my/
Sitemap: https://spprecisionparts.my/sitemap.xml

- Address: No. 15, Jalan Selesa Indah 9, Taman Selesa Indah, 81300 Skudai, Johor
- WhatsApp and phone: +60 16-759 5988 (https://wa.me/60167595988)
- Email: Lpcarauto89@outlook.com
- Company: S & P Precision Parts Sdn Bhd (202501042777 (1644185-P))
- Brand: Monaer (摩纳尔)

## Products
- [Brake pads](https://spprecisionparts.my/products/brake-pads/): Nano ceramic pads for daily cars, premium models and EVs.
- [Brake discs](https://spprecisionparts.my/products/brake-discs/): High-carbon discs with a silver anti-rust coating.
- [Brake fluid and brake care](https://spprecisionparts.my/products/brake-fluid-care/): DOT 4 and DOT 5.1 brake fluid, cleaner spray, grease and gloves.

## For drivers
- [Find Monaer brake pads for your car](https://spprecisionparts.my/part-finder/)
- [Find a Monaer workshop in Malaysia](https://spprecisionparts.my/find-a-workshop/)

## For workshops
- [Become an authorised Monaer workshop](https://spprecisionparts.my/become-authorised-workshop/)
